description: 精銳保全（trooper_elite）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 精銳保全

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. an elite Skydome corporate security trooper, slightly taller and broader than a regular trooper, about seven heads tall: a darker charcoal-blue armored tactical uniform with an extra layered shoulder pauldron with a bright orange rank stripe, a heavier chest armor plate, a full closed helmet with a dark visor and a small antenna, forearm guards, knee pads, black combat boots, dark gloves.
